name: Skorn Whitecloud
summary: At Bloodhoof Village, Skorn Whitecloud guides young hunters and helps travelers face Mulgore’s dangers.

sections.title: A Guide on the Golden Plains
sections.body: Skorn Whitecloud lives at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore and teaches young hunters the ways of the hunt. He shows them to respect the wild creatures of the plains. First, they prove themselves against cunning flatland prowlers. Then they take the claws to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff. Skorn wants every hunter who takes up bow or spear to understand the balance between predator and prey.

sections.title: Vigilance Against the Unnatural
sections.body: Across Mulgore’s savannah, Skorn Whitecloud watches for strange disturbances. Demonic corruption can mark the wildlife and beasts of the plains. When signs appear, Skorn helps piece together what happened. He keeps the tribes alert to malevolent forces entering their ancestral home.

faq.q: Where can Skorn Whitecloud be found?
faq.answer: Skorn Whitecloud can be found at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore’s southern grasslands.

faq.q: What role does Skorn play for young hunters?
faq.answer: Skorn Whitecloud teaches young hunters the principles of the hunt through The Hunter's Way. He sends them to prove their tracking and combat skills against cunning flatland prowlers, then directs them to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
Skorn Whitecloud offers Skorn's Hammer or Skorn's Rifle to a hunter who brings proof that the great wolf Ghost Howl has fallen. His own hunting days are over.

faq.q: Is Skorn Whitecloud related to any other tauren in Mulgore?
faq.answer: No relatives of Skorn Whitecloud are named in Mulgore. He is an old hunter of Bloodhoof Village, and his hunting days are behind him.

angles.text: As a young tauren hunter, you can learn from Skorn Whitecloud to stalk swift predators like the flatland prowler and honor the spiritual harmony of the hunt.
As a tauren, you can see in Skorn the elders’ duty to pass on the honor of the hunt and the practical wisdom of a long life on the plains.
